Watch left-handers Tanner Scott and Alex Vesia in the Dodgers bullpen.

briefings.headline: Change speeds, trust the rested late-inning group
briefings.message: J.T. Ginn starts as the only ready option; cap him at 85 pitches. Against lefties, feature the changeup: Ginn allows xwOBA 0.347 vs LHB, and his changeup xwOBA allowed is 0.209. Tommy Edman’s favorable offspeed figures are small-sample, so don’t overread them.
